review_method: Coordinator directly viewed saved image against frozen criteria before receiving child pixel grades. Separate review, not an external blinded benchmark.
topic_observable: Reference-guided foreground vocalist at a pop-filter/microphone, headphones and marked lyric pages, with two bandmates and producer behind a framed control-room window and three colored waveform lanes.

criteria.evidence: Large readable face retains dark chin-length bob, fine fringe, rounded dark eyes, tapered cheeks and full lips as visible appearance cues.
Hand touches headphone earcup, mouth is open toward pop filter and condenser mic; face remains clear.

Two raised fingers are visible but can also read as a V pose; the singer gaze angles up-left and its exact endpoint cannot confidently be tied to that same hand. The full directed cue relation is ambiguous.

The producer looks toward the booth with one hand at/near his mouth. No finger-to-console talkback control contact is visible; console endpoint and other hand are obscured. Generic presence does not establish the required talkback action.

Lead plus two bandmates, corresponding color-marked pages and three differently colored waveform lanes jointly form a group-production context. Waveforms do not establish their actual audio content or idol employment.
Visible hands have plausible articulations and separate owners; headphone contact and page grip are coherent, with a clear glass/window boundary.
Lead face dominates while both bandmates, finger cue, producer and track display remain legible as secondary context.

controls_pixel_description: Ordinary recording-room photography with a clothed sleeveless rehearsal top, absorbed expression and warm/cool lighting; no fetish prop focus or surreal transformation. Understated attraction intent is plausible; user appeal remains unassessed.
source_use_causal_gain: Unestablished: frozen baseline retained exactly, used_new_CIDs empty.

review_reconciliation.reason: Parallel child review identified an endpoint ambiguity also present in the pixels. Applying the frozen complete-evidence rule conservatively; timing is not inferred from a V-shaped hand.
review_reconciliation.C4_classification_difference: Child labels required talkback omission FAIL; coordinator labels hidden console endpoint UNOBSERVABLE. Both reject a pass.
